name: Exalted Future
source:
Yathor is a sky island and a home to all sorts of unique species for all to live at. During this time, a new governor must be chosen to keep Yathor in place. The story follows librarian employee and college graduate, Jay. While working at her library, she hears rumor of the societal corruption organization known as The Igniters, plotting to burn down Yathor by teaming up with one of the running politicians. It’s up to Jay and the citizens of Yathor to figure out who is behind The Igniters attacks and take them down to protect their homes.


[from [url=https://gcastelini.itch.io/exalted-future]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
亚索尔是一座天空之岛，是各种独特物种的家园，可供所有人居住。在此期间，必须选出一位新总督来保住亚索尔的职位。故事讲述的是图书馆员、大学毕业生杰伊。在图书馆工作时，她听到了有关名为“点火者”的社会腐败组织的谣言，该组织密谋与一位竞选政客联手烧毁亚索尔。杰伊和亚瑟尔的居民有责任查明谁是点火者袭击的幕后黑手，并打倒他们以保护他们的家园。


[来自[url=https://gcastelini.itch.io/exalted-future]itch.io[/url]]
